CST_DEGRADED:recovery.why: the CST wrote too many error nodes: a grammar recovery problem, not a reader disagreement

CST_MISSING_KIND:call.why: the lexer recorded a call the CST has no node for: the value reader and its call emission

CST_MISSING_KIND:constant.why: a Rust item read as a value (a const or static) writes no event in the CST

CST_MISSING_KIND:symbol.why: the block head did not open the symbol the CST names: class_head and function_head

CST_MISSING_KIND:var.why: a binding the CST records and the lexer did not: assignment target detection

CST_SHAPE_MISMATCH:targets.why: the two readers agree on the line but not on the shape of the targets

LEX_OVER_EMIT:call.why: the lexer invented a callee: call detection in the value reader

LEX_OVER_EMIT:name.why: the lexer invented a name the CST never writes: the value reader's merges

PAIR_AMBIGUOUS:1.why: both readers wrote an event on the line and they cannot be paired: the classifier decides, the readers must agree
